_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.

items.text: NEW: when you're working a merge in the ✨ Suggested-merges sidebar (or a per-row ⚇ Merge), the big CCR table now SYNCS to it — the course you're on plus its same-subject neighbors float to the TOP of the list and the focused row is highlighted, so you can always see where it sits without scrolling. It's still a full list (scroll past the floated rows to reach true adjacents). Turn it off with the 'Sync the CCR list to the current course' checkbox in the sidebar. Tell me if the float helps or if you'd rather the table never moved.

Two ways to steer the worklist now: a ‹ Prev / Next › pager at the bottom of the sidebar (walk the queue without the keyboard), and a Discipline filter up top (narrow the suggested merges to one discipline at a time — e.g. just Foreign Languages, or just Nursing). Say if you want the pager somewhere more reachable.

The candidate strength slider now STARTS toward Loose — so more courses SIMILAR to the one you're merging are already in the list (unchecked) when the sidebar opens; drag toward Tight if it's too many. And the editor's own keyword box is GONE — the single Search box at the top of the sidebar is now the one place to type, and it takes MULTIPLE terms separated by commas (comma = OR, e.g. 'digital, imag' surfaces both). Flag it if the Loose default pulls in too much noise.

Course levels: each candidate now shows a Beg / Int / Adv chip and the Levels filter reads Beg · Int · Adv · Lab · WkExp (we briefly tried Level 1/2/3 and reverted to Beg/Int/Adv on your call). It classifies by Title-5 §55050 — explicit ranges (1-2/3-4/5-6) and words/ordinals are reliable; a bare single number ('Spanish 3') is just a HINT you can override, since the same title can be Int in a long ladder or Adv in a short one. Eyeball a language or ESL family and correct any level that reads wrong.

Carry-over from S70 (still worth doing): the worklist groups WORD VARIANTS — 'Conversational Japanese' ↔ 'Japanese Conversation', 'Assisting' ↔ 'Assistant' (~866 more group). Confirm the clean language-conversation families when you get a chance. Where a group shows an amber '⚠ Spans N disciplines' note, eyeball it for homonyms (music vs office 'keyboard') before confirming.
Standing bonus: we'll keep adding Arroyo-Seco-style California plein-air landscapes (Redmond, Guy Rose, Wendt, Payne) to First Light — flag any artist/work you'd love and we'll source it.

When the merge wave settles (NOT per-merge): the unverified-M-ID renumber re-mint — close gaps + re-sort 001,002… by title within each (canonical SUBJ4, band). Full Rule-7, unverified-only, ONE pass. Scope: docs/unverified_mid_renumber_scope.md. Dry-run first, Sam's go before apply + Supabase re-key.

TMC Phase-2 ACCEPTANCE ENGINE in tmc_builder.js (Sam: 'Go for A'): per-slot verdict from the ASCCC rules (C-ID match = ✓ · slot.flexible = ⚠ accept-with-ASSIST · specific C-ID filled by a non-match = faculty review · unfilled = ○) + structural checklist + a Ready/N-issues banner. Consume slot.flexible + t.flexibility (#479). Scope: docs/kb-notes/tmc-co-review-scope.md.

CPL-Assistant CCR/CER-grounded recommender ETL (green-lit, queued): build the CCR/CER/adoption-leverage ETL into shared Supabase so the Assistant can recommend the likely local course + credit rec. Scope: docs/kb-notes/cpl-assistant-ccr-cer-recommendation-scope.md.
